_comment: Curated registry of single-cell RNA-seq foundation models. This is the one
file maintained by hand; everything else in data/ is generated.
papers   - every version of the model paper (preprint AND journal). Citing
works are unioned across versions and deduped by OpenAlex work id,
so listing both does not double-count.
openalex - filled in by resolve_ids.py; do not edit by hand.
params   - parameter count, or null if the paper does not state one.
cells    - number of cells in the pretraining corpus.
tasks    - annotation | integration | imputation | perturbation | grn | spatial
license  - SPDX id where known; 'non-commercial' flags restricted weights.
Leave a field null rather than guessing - nulls render as 'not reported'.

models.name: scGPT

papers.title: scGPT: toward building a foundation model for single-cell multi-omics using generative AI
scGPT: Towards Building a Foundation Model for Single-Cell Multi-omics Using Generative AI

models.notes: Generative transformer over gene tokens; the most widely benchmarked scFM.

models.name: Geneformer

papers.title: Transfer learning enables predictions in network biology

models.notes: Rank-value encoding of expression; distributed primarily through Hugging Face. Corpus later expanded to ~95M cells.

models.name: scBERT

papers.title: scBERT as a large-scale pretrained deep language model for cell type annotation of single-cell RNA-seq data

models.notes: Earliest widely cited scRNA transformer; Performer backbone.

papers.title: Large-scale foundation model on single-cell transcriptomics

models.name: UCE (Universal Cell Embeddings)

papers.title: Universal Cell Embeddings: A Foundation Model for Cell Biology

models.notes: Zero-shot, protein-embedding gene representation; works across species without retraining.

models.name: CellPLM

papers.title: CellPLM: Pre-training of Cell Language Model Beyond Single Cells

models.notes: Treats cells as tokens and models inter-cell relationships; includes spatial data in pretraining.

papers.title: scMulan: a multitask generative pre-trained language model for single-cell analysis

models.name: GeneCompass

papers.title: GeneCompass: deciphering universal gene regulatory mechanisms with a knowledge-informed cross-species foundation model

models.notes: Cross-species (human + mouse) pretraining with injected prior knowledge.

models.name: Nicheformer

papers.title: Nicheformer: a foundation model for single-cell and spatial omics

models.notes: Joint dissociated + spatial pretraining; included for spatial-task comparison.

models.name: LangCell

papers.title: LangCell: Language-Cell Pre-training for Cell Identity Understanding

models.notes: Contrastive cell-text pretraining; supports zero-shot cell type identification.

models.name: tGPT

papers.title: Generative pretraining from large-scale transcriptomes for single-cell deciphering

models.notes: Autoregressive pretraining over gene rank sequences; bulk + single-cell corpus.

models.name: SCimilarity

papers.title: Scalable querying of human cell atlases via a foundational model reveals commonalities across fibrosis-associated macrophages

models.notes: Metric-learning cell search rather than a masked-token transformer; included as a strong retrieval baseline.

models.name: CellFM

papers.title: CellFM: a large-scale foundation model pre-trained on transcriptomics of 100 million human cells

models.notes: Largest human-only scRNA model at release; strong showing in 2026 benchmark reviews.

models.name: Cell2Sentence / C2S-Scale

papers.title: Cell2Sentence: Teaching Large Language Models the Language of Biology

models.notes: Converts cells into gene-name sentences and fine-tunes a general LLM; C2S-Scale extends this to much larger backbones.

models.name: scPRINT

papers.title: scPRINT: pre-training on 50 million cells allows robust gene network predictions

models.notes: Explicitly targets gene-network inference rather than embedding quality alone.

models.name: AIDO.Cell

papers.title: Scaling Dense Representations for Single Cell with Transcriptome-Scale Context

models.notes: Reads the full transcriptome as context instead of a truncated gene set; 3M/10M/100M/650M sizes.

models.name: STATE

papers.title: Predicting cellular responses to perturbation across diverse contexts with State

models.notes: Perturbation-first design; the current reference point for in-silico perturbation claims.

papers.title: A cross-species generative cell atlas across 1.5 billion years of evolution: The TranscriptFormer single-cell model

models.name: CellHermes

papers.title: Language may be all omics needs: Harmonizing multimodal data for omics understanding with CellHermes

models.notes: LoRA-finetuned Llama-3.1-8B that recasts expression profiles and PPI networks as natural-language question-answer pairs; acts as encoder, predictor and explainer in one model.
